title: Lakanmi v Attorney-General (Western) (1971)
summary: Early Nigerian case on military decrees and constitutional continuity—often cited in legal history teaching.
principle: Constitutional order during military rule transitions.

title: AG Abia v AG Federation (Resource control litigation)
summary: Supreme Court jurisprudence on federal resource allocation and derivation principles (ongoing constitutional debate).

title: Inakoju v Adeleke (2007)
summary: Electoral and impeachment procedure disputes illustrating separation of powers in Nigerian democracy.

title: Mojekwu v Mojekwu (1997)
summary: Customary law inheritance practices assessed for consistency with constitutional non-discrimination values.
principle: Customary law, gender equality, and fundamental rights.

title: Constitutional cases on electoral mandates (illustrative bundle)
summary: Early republic-era election petitions show how courts police mandate disputes under the Constitution.
principle: Electoral justice and judicial role in democracy.
